observed_statements: The BMV’s Driver’s Manual contains the latest information you will need to successfully pass an operator’s knowledge examination (written test) and obtain an Indiana driver’s license.
Printed manuals are updated a maximum of one time each year and could contain outdated information.
The most up-to-date version of the Indiana Driver’s Manual is in electronic format and available for download below in several different languages.
edition_claim: Edition line 'Published July 2026' printed only on the back cover (physical page 84: 'Published July 2026 | Check IN.gov/BMV for updates'); the front cover (physical page 1) prints no edition
